'''Harvey S. Leff''' (July 24, 1937 – December 30, 2023) was an American physicist and physics teacher who is known primarily for his research and expository articles in physics, focusing on [[energy]], [[entropy]], [[Maxwell's demon]], and the foundations of [[thermodynamics]]. He introduced the 'energy spreading' metaphor for entropy change.<ref>{{cite journal | url=https://aapt.scitation.org/doi/abs/10.1119/1.18389 | doi=10.1119/1.18389 | title=Thermodynamic entropy: The spreading and sharing of energy | date=1996 | last1=Leff | first1=Harvey S. | journal=American Journal of Physics | volume=64 | issue=10 | pages=1261–1271 | bibcode=1996AmJPh..64.1261L | url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | url=https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10701-007-9163-3 | doi=10.1007/s10701-007-9163-3 | title=Entropy, Its Language, and Interpretation | date=2007 | last1=Leff | first1=Harvey S. | journal=Foundations of Physics | volume=37 | issue=12 | pages=1744–1766 | bibcode=2007FoPh...37.1744L | url-access=subscription }}</ref> Leff died on December 30, 2023, at the age of 86.<ref>{{cite web |title=Harvey Leff |url=https://www.holmansfuneralservice.com/obituaries/Harvey-Leff?obId=30240021 |website=Holman's Funeral & Cremation Service |access-date=7 February 2024}}</ref>

==Career==
Leff was a faculty member at the Case Institute of Technology and [[Case Western Reserve University]], [[Chicago State University]], [[Harvey Mudd College]] and was a scientist and energy policy analyst at the Institute for Energy Analysis at [[Oak Ridge Associated Universities]]. For most of his career, he was professor at [[California State Polytechnic University-Pomona]]. In 2010, he became a visiting scholar at [[Reed College]].

==Publications==
Leff was author of a monograph on energy and entropy,<ref>[https://www.worldcat.org/oclc/1145924398 Energy and Entropy: A Dynamic Duo, CRC Press, Aug 2020]</ref> co-edited two editions of a book on Maxwell's demon,<ref>[http://worldcat.org/oclc/50940631 Maxwell's Demon 2: Entropy, Classical and Quantum Information, Computing, Institute of Physics, Bristol, 2003. Co-editor: A. F. Rex]</ref><ref>[http://worldcat.org/oclc/940922296 Maxwell's Demon: Entropy, Information, Computing, Princeton University Press and Adam Hilger/British Institute of Physics, 1990. Co-editor: A. F. Rex.]</ref> published research articles,<ref>[https://scholar.google.com/scholar?start=20&q=Harvey+S.+Leff&hl=en&as_sdt=0,38 Google Scholar search for Harvey S. Leff]</ref> and a website on energy and entropy.<ref>{{usurped|1=[https://web.archive.org/web/20141115055852/http://energyandentropy.com/ All About Energy & Entropy]}}</ref>

==Honors==
Leff was a Fellow of the [[American Association of Physics Teachers]]<ref>[https://www.aapt.org/Programs/awards/upload/2014-Fellows-List_Updated.pdf AAPT Fellows 2014]</ref> and a Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]].<ref>[https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=L&year=2019&unit_id=&institution= APS Fellows 2017]</ref> He was an associate editor and consulting editor for the ''[[American Journal of Physics]]'', and was president of the American Association of Physics Teachers.<ref>[https://aapt.org/aboutaapt/history/officers.cfm AAPT Officers, Past and Present]</ref>
